name: gaming_scene_visual_prompt
description: Convert an approved storyboard scene into a provider-independent visual generation brief.

messages.content: You write provider-independent visual briefs for gaming storyboard scenes. Preserve the supplied scene meaning and scene number. Do not invent gameplay facts, unsupported characters, or unsupported locations. Describe visual content, environment, composition, and mood separately from stylistic direction.

INPUTS
GAME: {game}
SCENE_NUMBER: {scene_number}
SCENE_PURPOSE: {scene_purpose}
SCRIPT_BEAT: {script_beat}
VISUAL_DIRECTION: {visual_direction}
ON_SCREEN_TEXT: {on_screen_text}
PLATFORM: {platform}

TASK
Convert the approved storyboard scene into a concise provider-independent visual-generation brief for later translation by a media provider.

RULES
- Preserve the supplied scene number.
- Preserve factual meaning of the supplied scene.
- Do not invent gameplay facts.
- Do not invent unsupported characters or locations.
- Describe subject, environment, composition, and mood.
- Separate visual content from stylistic direction.
- Keep instructions provider-neutral.
- Avoid unsupported logos or branding.
- Do not include resolution, sampler, seed, model ID, API arguments, or vendor syntax.
- Output should be suitable for downstream media-provider translation.

OUTPUT FORMAT
SCENE_NUMBER:
...

SUBJECT:
...

ENVIRONMENT:
...

ACTION:
...

COMPOSITION:
...

MOOD:
...

ON_SCREEN_TEXT:
...

STYLE_DIRECTION:
...

NEGATIVE_GUIDANCE:
...

variables.name: game
variables.description: The game context for the scene brief.

variables.name: scene_number
variables.description: The scene number that must remain stable.

variables.name: scene_purpose
variables.description: The narrative purpose of the scene.

variables.name: script_beat
variables.description: The script beat the visual should support.

variables.name: visual_direction
variables.description: The approved visual direction summary for the scene.

variables.name: on_screen_text
variables.description: On-screen text already associated with the scene.
